question: Does the stand-in ratio read the update's kind (performed vs new) or its breadth (broad vs targeted)? E53's pair confounds the two: lowercase (performed, broad: G per off-target KL 4.1-4.5) read 0.92-0.93, the 50-word cipher (new, targeted: 11-15) read 0.26. This pair swaps breadth: narrow lowercase is performed and targeted, the broad cipher new and broad.

check.rule: W0 (teacher.teacher_net(model, {})), Pile val rows 0-255, A0's statistic (a0.spread: mean over positions, 90% interval resampling rows, 2,000 resamples, seed 0). narrow_lower: log p(lowercase form) - log p(capitalised form) at narrow_lower's positions in its rows; cased: the same positions and forms in the cased rows; broad_cipher: log p(pi(x)) - log p(x) at its positions in its rows. STOP (written, FAIL logged, exit 1 before any fine-tune) iff narrow_lower mean < 1.0 (not 'performs', A0's bar), or broad_cipher mean > -3.0 (not 'cannot', A0's bar), or any of the three means is not finite. cased <= -1.0 is reported (A0's 'follows the style'), not a stop. No positions raises (an error, never a pass). Reported beside each mean: the mean over repeats (the form a already earlier in the row, which induction can copy) and over first occurrences. A STOP goes to the user with the numbers before anything else runs.
check.tokenizer_counts: Measured 2026-10-30 on CPU (tokenizer only): narrow_lower 354 positions in 144 of val rows 0-255 (145 repeats), 273 with a whole window; broad_cipher 10,824 in 246 rows (3,278 repeats), 8,137 with a whole window. E53 for comparison (same code): cipher 2,916 positions, 2,198 windows; lowercase 6,070 positions (a0.json), 4,598 windows.

controls.rules: Run first and alone; any miss writes the results, logs FAIL and exits 1. (a1_finetune) the check above, then bf16_save: every state's held-out gain from its saved bf16 copy within 0.005 of the fp32 state's (E53's rule; the recipe control is E53's lowercase batch order 0 and does not apply to these tasks, kept only because finetune_all is shared). (a1_read) e53_repro, first: E53's lowercase batch-order-0 step-300 state (results/large/dW_lowercase_s0_step300.pt, sha256 as finetune.json) split and read by this code, before any new state; G within 0.02 nats of read.json's 1.6708 and stand-in ratio (masked gain / subcomponent gain) within 0.01 of read.json's 0.9186 (both read from read.json at run time). Tolerances: 0.02 nats is the plan's bf16 rounding of one restore; 0.01 the ratio's expected window noise at 500 windows (E53 plan, 'Noise floor'); on the same card and code both should be met near exactly. Unlike E53's zero and do-nothing controls (true by construction, dropped here), this one can fail: it checks that the extended code and the card reproduce E53's ratio on a state whose reading is known.

definitions.narrow_lower: Cased Pile train rows 0-2399 (E53's cipher rows) with 50 title-case word tokens mapped to their lowercase forms at every occurrence, context and targets, token level (performed.cipher_rows with performed.title_lower_map). The 50: tokens matching ^Ġ[A-Z][a-z]+$ (a space, a capital, one or more lowercase letters) whose lowercase form 'Ġ' + rest.lower() is one vocabulary entry, ranked by count on Pile train rows 0-4095 (performed.word_ranks, descending count, ties by id), ranks 50-99 of that list (0-based): mid frequency, as E53's cipher's ranks 50-99. Forms without a leading space (row or line starts) stay cased. Scored positions: row index >= 1 where the cased token is one of the 50 (a = lowercase form, b = capitalised form). The 50 are written to check_amend1.json ('maps'); they are, in rank order: With, License, National, Since, Cir, Suppose, May, Although, March, Ch, While, Section, Figure, County, City, String, Dr, World, My, Sh, South, God, First, De, Th, Cl, President, Now, From, Furthermore, Le, How, Here, Am, Ex, His, North, Un, Id, Health, Moreover, List, Department, Par, Some, Get, Also, Be, House, Theorem.
definitions.broad_cipher: Cased Pile train rows 0-2399 with pi applied at every occurrence, context and targets, token level (performed.cipher_rows): pi = performed.derangement(seed 0) of the 500 word tokens (^Ġ[a-z]{2,}$, E53's WORD) of frequency ranks 50-549 on Pile train rows 0-4095 (performed.word_ranks; E53's 50 are ranks 50-99, a subset, mapped differently here). Scored positions: row index >= 1 whose original token is in pi's domain (a = pi(x), b = x).
definitions.fine-tunes: E53's recipe unchanged (lowercase.arm_b_states 'adam': all 24 decomposed matrices, Adam 3e-5, batch 8, 300 steps, each row once, clip 1, next-token loss on every position), batch orders 0 and 1 (lowercase.batch_order), saved bf16 at steps 10, 100 and 300 for both members. Held-out rows for the training log: the member's map on val rows 0-63.
definitions.windows, T, U, L, G, g, subcomponent gai: As E53's predictions.json, unchanged: up to 500 windows of 127 tokens per member from val rows 0-255 (narrow_lower has 273, all used), seed 0; least-squares split (anchors.lifted); F = max(0.1, 2 x max(|G|, |subcomponent gain|) of the member's KL-matched random delta-W, 2 x the row's standard error of the subcomponent gain); a ratio is read iff G and subcomponent gain both reach min(1 nat, F) and the three numbers are finite.
definitions.kl_other: The full model's mean KL(W0 || state) over the 126 window positions other than the scored one (local_faith.stats, as E53's cells).
definitions.breadth: G per off-target KL: G / kl_other of a step-300 split row (score.breadth). High = targeted (much gain at the scored positions for little change elsewhere), low = broad. None unless G > 0 and kl_other > 0, both finite. E53: lowercase 4.06-4.46, cipher 14.5-15.0 at step 300.
definitions.positions touched: Reported: the share of training-row tokens (positions >= 1) the member's map changes (finetune_amend1.json 'train_share'), and the scored-position counts above. Measured: narrow_lower 0.0027, broad_cipher 0.0907, E53's cipher 0.0242.

rules.swap: Scored gate. 'achieved' iff all four step-300 breadths are read and min over seeds of narrow_lower's breadth >= 1.5 x max over seeds of broad_cipher's. Not achieved (including unread) -> outcome 'not read (swap missed)': the ratios are reported, the pair is not read on kind or breadth.
rules.P1: As E53's P1 on the new pair: a = narrow_lower ratios (seeds 0, 1, step 300), b = broad_cipher's. gap = min(a) - max(b); reverse_gap = max(a) - min(b). 'separates' iff gap >= 0.3; 'reversed' iff reverse_gap <= -0.3; 'unscored' iff any ratio is None or not finite (or a list is empty); else 'does not separate'.
rules.outcome: Scored, in order: swap not achieved -> 'not read (swap missed)'; P1 unscored -> 'unscored'; separates -> 'kind' (the ratio follows performed vs new with breadth swapped); reversed -> 'breadth' (it follows broad vs targeted); does not separate and all four ratios >= 0.7 -> 'neither (both high)'; does not separate and all four <= 0.5 -> 'neither (both low)'; any other 'does not separate' -> 'both' (the pair converges between the ends: kind and breadth each carry part of E53's gap). 'neither' reads: only the new-and-targeted cell (E53's cipher) reads low, or only the performed-and-broad cell (E53's lowercase) reads high: an interaction, or another property of the tasks, not kind or breadth alone.
rules.predictions: Kind (the filed hypothesis to test): outcome 'kind', with narrow_lower >= 0.7 and broad_cipher <= 0.5 on both seeds (leans_reported). Breadth: outcome 'breadth' (narrow_lower low, broad_cipher high). An additive mix: 'both'. Lean, not scored: 'kind' at 0.4, 'both' 0.3, 'breadth' 0.15, 'neither' 0.15; the swap achieved (narrow_lower >= 1.5 x broad_cipher in breadth) at 0.8 (broad_cipher maps 9% of training tokens, narrow_lower 0.3%).
rules.reported: Every row's cells, G, g, subcomponent gain, masked gain, kl_other, piece_se and bootstrap interval (as E53); breadth at steps 10 and 100 too; P1 at the plain 1-nat bar; leans (narrow_lower ratio >= 0.7, broad_cipher <= 0.5 per row); matched gain per seed (the broad_cipher step whose G is nearest narrow_lower's step-300 G, and the narrow_lower step nearest broad_cipher's, ties to the earlier step, with ratios); E53's step-300 and cipher rows from read.json as reference (G, kl_other, breadth, ratio); effects_reported: the 2 x 2 on seed means at step 300, kind effect = (lowercase + narrow_lower - cipher - broad_cipher) / 2, breadth effect = (lowercase + broad_cipher - cipher - narrow_lower) / 2 (None if any is unread). Under pure kind the kind effect is about 0.66 and breadth 0; under pure breadth the reverse.
rules.edge_cases: Run before filing (score.score_amend1 and its parts on synthetic rows, CPU, 2026-10-30; record in the plan's Amendment 1 section): empty lists, a None or NaN ratio, inf, G <= 0 or kl_other = 0 or NaN in a breadth, a swap exactly at 1.5 x (achieved), swap missed with P1 separating (not read), ties at gap 0.3 and reverse -0.3, all four at exactly 0.7 (neither both high) and 0.5 (neither both low), a mixed does-not-separate (both), unread E53 or new rows in the effects (None), every outcome branch.
rules.relative_or_absolute: All thresholds absolute: ratios unitless, gains in nats of log-odds, breadth in nats per nat, the swap factor a ratio of breadths.

dropped: E53's hand write (the G-matched write on block 1's MLP output) is dropped: in E53 both writes hit the alpha cap without reaching their target, and a write into one matrix on both tasks would not separate breadth either (analysis, 'Did the nulls land'). The relay is not read (E53: it did not separate, and it is not this amendment's question). E53's zero-update and do-nothing controls are dropped: true by construction (E53 code review, item 1).
blind_to: Ratio: the real model (read in Gamma's stand-in); whether the subcomponent changes themselves matter. Kind vs task family: narrow_lower is a lowercase task and broad_cipher a cipher task, as in E53, so 'kind' here cannot be told from 'lowercase-family vs cipher-family'; no task-matched null runs. Breadth is measured one way (G per off-target KL at the scored windows), not by any other definition. A high reading means 'uses pieces the original model has', never 'uses a circuit it already runs' (decisions.md, 'Limit of the elicitation reading').
positive_control: e53_repro: E53's lowercase seed-0 state must read again G 1.6708 and ratio 0.9186 on this code; E53's own pair (0.92 vs 0.26) is the reference the outcome is read against.
noise_floor: Ratio: E53's 90% intervals over windows were +-0.03 (cipher, 500 windows) to +-0.06 (lowercase); narrow_lower has 273 windows, so about +-0.08 expected; seed spread <= 0.011 in E53. The 0.3 bar is about four times the widest expected half-interval. Breadth: E53's seeds differed by up to 10% (4.06 vs 4.46); the 1.5 factor is five times that.
not_sourced: The 1.5 swap factor (set above E53's 10% seed spread in breadth; E53's pair differed by 2.5x at the nearest rows); the ranks 50-99 for the title-case types and 50-549 for the cipher (mid frequency by analogy with E53's ranks 50-99); the cipher seed 0; the repro tolerances (from the plan's bf16 rounding and window noise, not measured across cards); the outcome leans.
